d: In front of the main gate of the castle, large lawn, and pleasant. You will arrive along long avenues cut into the woods, which surround it. The entrances of the avenues are embellished with crude spires, and military trophies. Elfrida, and Evelina.
Orgando, and Osmondo in common dress of hunters, advancing.
Elfrida, and Evelina, who pop into the meadow on a path, suddenly meet Orgando, and Osmondo.

Gallery, which leads to several apartments. It is a merry premise of instruments of breath, which mentions the jubilation of the arrival of Adelvolto, and then ends in the thunders appropriate to the instrumental recitative, which followed. Elfrida, Adelvolto hasty entering meet on the scene.
Orgando in dress according to his rank, and sayings.
All right, Elfrida, and then Siveno.
Elfrida, then Evelina.

Grandiose vestibule, which at the entrance of the castle corresponds. It is supported by Gothic arches, which lean on rough pillars. Far away sea view. Eggardo, and Cortigiani, Siveno, Guards, and Hunters. Adelvolto, and his Homes.
Orgando, and sayings.
Eggardo, Orgando, Siveno, Séguito.
Adelvolto, who then returns Elfrida, and Evelina.

Garden on the floor of some apartments that surround it from three sides. In the bottom is open in a loggia that leans over the woods, and you see in the distance the sea. Eggardo, and Siveno; then Elfrida, who enters running, then Orgando, who follows it hasty.
When he came to see that meeting, he was stunned, and confused, and said.
Rooms of the castle. Evelina, Osmondo.
Evelina alone.

Spacious, but thicket fenced for use of tournaments, and fights, surrounded by grassy seats in amphitheatre arranged. In the center, loggia for Spectators distinct on one side, on the other main barrier for the entrance of the Fighters. Military march, to the sound of which opens the barrier, entering the King with Cortigiani, Domestici, and Séguito. The King goes to take place with his on the loggia, housing the other in the seats of the amphitheatre. He closes, attached the King, the barrier, and then little reopened, enters Orgando armed with sword, and shield, and goes to settle near the loggia of the King, the barrier is closed, then again open enters Adelvoltto, settles in front of the loggia, straight to Orgando. Eggardo, Orgando, Adelvolto, Osmondo, Siveno, Guardie, and Spectatori.
The mark of the dagger is sounded, and at the point it appears at the barrier with armored Séguito Elfrida.
Eggardo, Orgando, Osmondo, Siveno, and Séguito.
Gallery that leads to several apartments. Adelvolto, then Siveno.
Then Elfrida.

Orgando, and Elfrida.

Armroom used among the ancient peoples of the north, everywhere in symmetry to the suspended walls. Above the cornices, which hold the vault, banners, and waving flags. On the pyramids plane formed with the same weapons, and war chariots, which support trophies. Elfrida, Adelvolto, and Domestici.
Eggardo, Séguito, and sayings.
